objects: one current source permanent and logical incarnation
events: resolve one fixed positive Monstrosity instruction
state_writes: monstrous designation and fixed Monstrosity value
timing: the monstrous condition is checked on resolution rather than as an activation restriction
choices: counter-replacement ordering remains scoped to the affected permanent's controller
hidden_information: the designation, value, counters, and completion event are public
apnap: ordinary multiplayer priority and replacement ordering apply
layers: monstrous is a noncopiable designation rather than an ability or characteristic
replacement_effects: counter quantity replacements finish before the designation; preventing every counter does not prevent becoming monstrous
copy: a copy does not inherit the monstrous designation or stored value
control_change: the same battlefield object remains monstrous through control changes
zone_change: a zone change creates a new object and clears the prior monstrous designation
source_leaves: a missing, phased-out, or new source incarnation cannot become monstrous from the old stack object

implementation.component: quorune.compiler.self_counter_keyword_actions, quorune.semantic_choices.self_counter_keyword_actions, quorune.permanent_designations, and the canonical counter-placement transaction

known_blockers: zero or variable Monstrosity values are not lowered
compound Monstrosity instructions remain material residuals
monstrous-matters triggers and static abilities are not compiler closed
typed consumers of the stored CR 701.37c value are not implemented
copied or granted Monstrosity requires trusted typed ability fragments
